scheme_name: Assistance to Startups having a Significant Impact on Society
other_conditions: Recommended by an approved Nodal Institution
Open to any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare
Startups already benefiting under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible
Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept can apply
benefits_summary: Up to ₹10,00,000 financial assistance for innovative projects with significant social impact.
